Next.js · Next.js essentials

What is the difference between React.js and Next.js?

Answer

  • React is a UI library: components and rendering. You choose routing, data fetching, bundling, SSR setup yourself; typically a client-rendered SPA.
  • Next.js is a framework built on React that adds: file-based routing, SSR/SSG/ISR, React Server Components, API routes/route handlers, server actions, image/font/script optimization, middleware, built-in code splitting, and easy deployment (Vercel or Node).

Next.js gives better SEO and initial load and full-stack capability; plain React (Vite) is simpler for internal dashboards or apps behind login where SEO doesn't matter.
